notes.text: Route 1: Customer/Contact Sync (Contact new) - Creates or updates weclapp customer when HubSpot contact has no weclapp ID
Route 2: Customer/Contact Sync (Contact exists) - Creates or updates weclapp customer when HubSpot contact already has a weclapp ID
Route 3: Deal → Sales Order Sync - Fetches line items from the deal, aggregates them, and creates/updates a sales order in weclapp linked to the customer, contact, and deal data
